authorInspection.method: Fresh complete compact XML family views in four returned ranges, lines 1-35, 36-70, 71-105 and 106-137; complete raw character record, complete pinned SVG and five complete existing articles. Compact-family semantic equality is audited against fresh extraction from frozen bytes.
authorInspection.limits: Author inspection only, not independent review. Other comparison families, quiz candidates and source-only reading corroboration are not yet inspected. Hashes and returned ranges do not certify comprehension.

readingObservations.evidence: Actual frozen family 1398420, actual existing N2 article and actual Digital Daijisen character entry under ソウ listing 創作; 字通 also gives ソウ and links 創作.
readingObservations.decision: True existing spelling/reading identity supports reuse. Preserve N2 vocabulary metadata, all thirteen direct exclusions and both creative-work/fabrication senses; do not infer a word level from the new N1 kanji.

readingObservations.evidence: Frozen KANJIDIC2 lists this exact second on reading. The inspected 字通 and Digital Daijisen blocks list ソウ; absence there does not invalidate ショウ.
readingObservations.decision: Retain exact source metadata/order. No confirmed lexical allocation or usefulness disposition yet; do not transfer the initial しょう of 傷創 しょうそう to the second character 創.

readingObservations.evidence: Full family 1597890 includes 作る/造る/創る with つくる. Its first sense's note says 創る usually concerns creating; artistic creation is also a separate sense. Actual existing 作る article explicitly discusses this spelling tendency.
readingObservations.decision: Do not manufacture fixed semantic compartments or infer every sense/collocation equally idiomatic with every spelling. Inspect necessary support identity and actual useful example before selecting a quiz key; existing 作る metadata does not declare 創.

readingObservations.evidence: Full family marks 創める as a rare kanji form. General starting sense 1 and auxiliary sense 3 are restricted to 始める; establishment/opening sense 2 is not so restricted.
readingObservations.decision: Keep rare spelling distinct from pronunciation rarity. Do not copy the existing 始める article's productive auxiliary rule or classroom examples as proof of unrestricted 創める substitution. Final lookup/quiz disposition pending.

readingObservations.evidence: Full 傷 family 1580260 marks standalone 創 as a rare kanji form; kana キズ is re_nokanji. Separate medical 創口 family has both そうこう and きずぐち.
readingObservations.decision: Do not imply ordinary 傷 spelling or its common pronunciation is rare. Existing 傷 article is a different written identity; no automatic new article or quiz support justified. Final lookup/quiz disposition pending.

readingObservations.evidence: Exact token occurs in frozen KANJIDIC2. No matching lexical example was established by inspecting all 137 families containing 創.
readingObservations.decision: Preserve raw token without repairing, deleting, reordering or inventing a word or gloss. No finding of source error or modern validity/rarity is established. Resolve appropriate qualified source-only treatment before runtime drafting.

familySpecificCautions.observation: 傷創 しょうそう is marked rare; the whole reading does not establish 創 ショウ.
創まる is search-only; 創む はじむ belongs to an archaic lower-bigrade verb family. Neither licenses the modern 始める auxiliary with 創.
Creative production/original work and fabrication are distinct senses; fiction need not be deception. Digital Daijisen's separate same-title magazine entry is not the selected lexical identity.
創傷 and 創痍 carry formal/literary flags; 満身創痍 has both bodily-wounds and figurative criticism senses. Do not infer universal register or a single injury-only meaning for 創.
絆創膏 has ばんそうこう, two re_nokanji katakana forms and a search-only kana form. Do not link a whole word to an article with a mismatched primary reading.
Search-only 切創 in the きりきず family is not the separate full 切創 せっそう identity; keep both families intact.
古創 and 手創 are rare spellings in the full 古傷/手傷 families, not proof that the ordinary words or pronunciations are rare.
創世期 is flagged irregular in the 創成期/創生期 early-period family; separate 創世期 そうせいき family 1398510 concerns creation of the world.
Historical policy and company-name entries are preserved as source context, not selected ordinary reading supports. ダイソー in the company-name family is not a new character-reading allocation.

remainingSourcePreparation: Complete and qualify all six reading dispositions, especially source-only ショウ and exact けず.しける; no fabricated correction or example.
Choose genuinely useful curated keys with spelling-matching support and necessary new articles only; preserve existing identities, levels, full metadata/order and exclusions.
Extract and inspect complete applicable comparison families/raw character records; audit target and all three actual distractor labels, ordinary secondary senses and any justified direct guards.
Finalize all-mapped reciprocal and activated-baseline links plus narrowly necessary reused passages.
Finish pinned converter/stroke and full proposed Han/font inventory; source SVG identity alone is not drawing/rendering acceptance.
Only then author a bounded runtime draft and obtain all unchanged textual, Android/native, combined-main, signing and publication gates.
